stroke_coordinate_policy: Keep all returned vertices in traversal order, without fitting, smoothing, interpolation, x sorting, joins or reference guidance
topology_policy: Preserve provided component and junction memberships; unresolved or inconsistent relationships require review or invalid conversion, never invented links
isolated_points: Retain separately and mark unsupported by the stroke-only native adapter; no connecting or silent dropping
axes_policy: Retain observed axes and tick evidence; derive origin from visible axis-line intersection only
scale_policy: Use at least two consistent numeric tick anchors per axis; otherwise null graph coordinates. Any derived affine calibration must preserve raw tick evidence separately and disclose residuals. No question ranges or manual calibration

calibration_screen.source: Existing Step 4A engineering calibration screen; not independent ground truth

native_policy: Run unchanged v1 validator and native guards. No import for unresolved marks/uncertainty, invalid geometry or failed fidelity screen; no production modification
reference_access: Only after the real response is saved; never from request runner
